subject: MAP: Hosting and Geo-override for PoC — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
messages:
From: Sana Rahman <sana.rahman@healthatlas.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@cloudops.io>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & PoC questions — hosting mode and geo

Ethan — thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. A couple of clarifying items from the HealthAtlas team as we draft the MAP and lock the PoC scope:

- Regulatory/geofence: we need data residency in the US for PHI-adjacent telemetry; ideally us-east region for latency to our customers.
- Mode preference: we want a hosted PoC to move fast, but our security team will need a quick assessment of Dedicated or Private if hosted can't meet audit controls.
- Timeline: MAP ideally done in 4 weeks; procurement needs an explicit list of deliverables and a pricing estimate to get approval.

Can you send a concise MAP (timeline + success criteria) and recommended default hosting mode for PoC with fallback options? Tom from procurement is CC'ed—he's our procurement lead.

Attachments: HealthAtlas_RFP_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Sana
Sana Rahman
Director, Product Operations
HealthAtlas
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Rahman <sana.rahman@healthatlas.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@cloudops.io>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & PoC questions — hosting mode and geo

Hi Sana / Tom — thanks for outlining the constraints. Draft MAP and high-level recommendation below; attached is an editable MAP workbook (RDW_MAP_v2.xlsx) with milestones and ownership.

Quick recommendation (PoC):
- Default: Hosted (us-east) for fastest time-to-value — we can provision a dedicated tenant and network isolation within hosted for the PoC window.
- Fallback 1: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool in us-east) — if your security team requires stronger isolation or SLA-backed latency targets.
- Fallback 2: Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) — engineering- and procurement-intensive; recommended only if Dedicated still fails audits.

MAP (4-week PoC) — summary:
- Week 0 (kickoff): exchange SSO/KMS expectations, finalize acceptance prompts and success criteria.
- Week 1: baseline performance tests (latency/throughput) against sample traffic; integration smoke tests.
- Week 2: quality evals (prompt sets), caching/batching tuning, cost estimate refinement.
- Week 3: security evidence handoff (SOC 2 artifact pointers, audit logs), final performance tuning.
- Week 4: acceptance gate + decision (hosted go-live, or schedule Dedicated verification).

Open questions for HealthAtlas (please confirm):
1) Final PoC region preference: us-east1 or us-east4?
2) Any non-negotiable controls that would force Private (e.g., HSM physical custody)?
3) Who will own procurement signature and PO (Tom? role)?

Next steps: I can schedule a 30-min kickoff next Tue if that works.

Attachments: RDW_MAP_v2.xlsx (editable)

—Ethan

Subject: Fwd: MAP & PoC questions — hosting mode and geo / action items

Team — forwarding HealthAtlas thread. They want a 4-week MAP with hosted PoC in us-east as default but may escalate to Dedicated/Private based on security review. Ask: can you help on the bullets below before I send the formal MAP to Sana?

Tasks:
- Laura: can you draft a short runbook for the PoC network/SSO/KMS handoff plus a checklist for SOC-2 artifacts we can hand over in Week 3? Include any expected evidence lead times.
- Marissa: please produce a quoted estimate for a hosted PoC (4 weeks) and a parallel quote for Dedicated (1-month reserved) and a Private feasibility high-level SOW stub. Keep it tight — procurement needs numbers ASAP.
- Vivek: any known capacity constraints in us-east for a 1–2 GPU pool for the PoC? Also call out quantization/latency tradeoffs I should highlight.

Target: I'll send the formal MAP and cost sheet to Sana by Mon EOD. Let me know blockers.

—Ethan
(Internal note forwarded)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP & PoC questions — hosting mode and geo / action items

Ethan — quick updates inline and attached a small architecture sketch (poC_arch_diagram.png) for the MAP kickoff packet.

Network/SSO/KMS notes:
- We can support SAML SSO with IdP metadata exchange on Day 0.
- KMS: default hosted option uses Redwood-managed envelope keys with customer-provided KMS integration (customers can supply AWS KMS keys). HSM-level custody (Private) requires additional procurement and on-prem key material — flag as high friction.
- SOC-2 evidence: we can provide scoped control docs (in-scope system description, logging config, recent pen-test summary) within 5 business days of formal request; full reports (attestations) require vendor authorization process.

Capacity/latency notes (for Vivek):
- For a 4-week PoC at low concurrency (burst to 30 qps), a 1–2 GPU shared tenant in us-east is straightforward. We recommend the following canary: start on hosted with prefix caching enabled, measure tail latency 99p, then if security requests isolation, shift to Dedicated with same workload settings.

Pricing note (Marissa): please ensure quotes include: base hosting usage (per-token), reserved GPU uplift (if Dedicated), and an engineering setup fee for Private feasibility (timeboxed estimate).

Attachments: poC_arch_diagram.png

4cc Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Ethan / team — this looks good. HealthAtlas confirms:

- We agree to proceed with a hosted PoC in us-east (us-east1 preferred) for the 4-week MAP.
- Acceptance criteria: latency under 200ms p95 for our sample prompts, documented audit artifacts (as Laura outlined) delivered in Week 3, and a cost estimate to inform procurement sign-off.
- Tom will own the PO; he and I will expect a short cost worksheet and MAP workbook to attach to the PO submission.

Next steps: please send a calendar invite for kickoff (30 min) next Tue and attach the RDW_MAP_v2.xlsx and the cost worksheet. We'll route NDA/DocuSign after kickoff if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.
Sana
